Compacted Gritty Earth

Compressed earth with a plain
texture and a few
cracks, such as oft-trodden paths
and yards. Mingle Dirt
and Coarse Dirt therewith for
variety. Its texture doth vary
with its place, and
grass cannot spread upon it.
Compacted Gritty Sand

Compressed sandy earth mingled with
stone grit, such as
the ground of machinery and
storage yards. Flowers scarcely thrive
upon it. Its texture
doth vary with its place.
Manufactory Dropper

A dropper for elaborate automatic
works, with twelve slots chosen
in turn. Sliders in its window
govern throwing force, angle, stack
size and the wait betwixt
throws. Three stack-comparison slots below
the inventory may serve as an
inward trigger, joined by AND
or OR. Join this inward
trigger to the outward redstone
trigger by AND or OR as
well. The shutter opens beforehand
when it is ready to
drop and awaits the outward
signal. All matching stacks are dropped
together. Hover over buttons for
2s to read their counsel.

Direction of dropping x/y (-45° to +45°)§r
§7Consult the green-red coordinates upon the front.
Stack to be dropped (1 to 32 items)

Joining the outward signal§r
§9AND§7: Drop only upon an outward signal.
§9OR§7: Drop filter matches unaided; other items require the outward trigger.
§9IGNORE§7: Heed no outward Redstone, as though the outward trigger were ever present.

Joining the filters§r
§9AND§7: Drop the stacks named by the filters only whilst ALL filters are green.
§9OR§7: Drop the stack of each several filter whilst that filter is green.
Wait betwixt drops (1s to 10s)

Outward Redstone signal light
§7(click to give a trigger by hand).

Manner of triggering§r
§9Pulse§7: Drop once for each OFF->ON of the outward signal.
§9Continuous§7: Keep dropping whilst the outward signal is ON.

Speed of dropping (slow to swift)
§7The spring is slack at the bottom and taut at the top.
Manufactory Conveyer

A conveyer for elaborate automatic works.
It shifts half-stacks and gathers over
at most 9x9. Sliders in its window
govern gathering reach (0 to 4),
the wait betwixt insertions (0.5s to
10s), and the inserted stack size
(1 to 32). Redstone controls in the
window: not inverted or inverted (the
default); pulse or continuous (the default).
Stack to be inserted §7(1 to 32 items)

Waiting light
§7Blinks whilst the insertion timer hath not expired, or the Conveyer cannot insert into the neighbouring inventory.
Redstone manner §7(inverted/not inverted/ignored)
Wait betwixt insertions §7(1s to 10s)
Gathering reach §7(0 to 4)
Outward Redstone signal light
Triggering manner §7(continuous/pulse)
Manufactory Block Setter

Sets blocks and plants crops or
trees. Redstone controls in its window:
not inverted or inverted (the default);
pulse or continuous (the default). Crop
seeds are planted in free space
above Ploughed Dirt. Items it cannot
set or plant are cast forth.
Redstone manner §7(click through normal/inverted/ignored)
Outward signal §7(click to perform one round of setting)

Stock row 3§r
§7Click to begin setting from the bottom storage row.

Stock row 2§r
§7Click to begin setting from the middle storage row.

Stock row 1§r
§7Click to begin setting from the top storage row.
Triggering manner §7(click to change continuous/pulse)
Barrel for Liquids

A plain barrel for keeping liquids,
with a little built-in gauge that measures
their height through a pressure tube.
It stands upright when set; sneak
whilst placing it to choose another direction.
Whilst upright it feeds liquids into
tanks below. It may be filled
or emptied whilst held as an item,
and gives a Redstone Metre signal.
Barrel filled: §6%1$s§r / %2$s mB of §6%3$s§r

Iron Bulb Light

Slab of Steel-Bound Cement

A grey-brown block of brick whose
texture doth vary with its place.

A slab of grey-brown brick.

Stairs wrought of grey-brown brick.

Little Block Breaker
Breaks the blocks before its working face. Send a redstone signal to stay its work. Its speed depends upon the block before it.
Charge: %1$s%% of %2$sRF§r | work: %3$s%%
Little Electric Furnace

A little furnace in a metal
case, with passage from inlet to
outlet. It draws items from the
inlet side and sets them in
the inventory at the outlet. Conveyers
may insert or withdraw items on
every side. Things that cannot be
smelted or cooked pass through unaltered.
Swifter and somewhat thriftier with energy
than a heated cobblestone furnace. Its
first-in, first-out queues and feeders move
whole stacks. The feeders require a
little power. Set a Conveyer in
an auxiliary slot to draw items
unaided from inventories beside the inlet.

Auxiliary slot
§7Set a Conveyer here to feed items unaided from the inlet side.
Charge %1$s%%, %2$srf/t
Choose thy smelting speed §7(OFF/I/II/III)
Little Funnel for Gathering Liquids

Gathers the liquids above it
into an inward tank of
three buckets. Follows running liquids
unto nearby source blocks. Draw
forth the liquid with
pipes or a bucket. By
gravity it fills only tanks
below. Works with the ordinary
creation of endless water sources.
Little Water Freezer

A device for making ice.
It chills Water into Ice, then
Press'd Ice, and lastly Blue
Ice. Click with a Water Bucket
or feed Water through a
pipe, and supply RF power.
A Conveyer or other item-withdrawing device
gathers whichever ice is present.
Remove RF power or send
a redstone signal to stay the
freezer. For automatic works, use
a Redstone Metre to learn which
stage of ice is present.
Little Assay Furnace

A little assay kiln in a
metal case, burning solid fuel with
an upward draught. Somewhat hotter and
better insulated than a cobblestone furnace,
and therefore thriftier. Two auxiliary slots
may serve for storage. Inward conveyer
queues for inlet, outlet and fuel
each hold two stacks in first-in,
first-out order. Put an External Heater
in an auxiliary slot and connect
power to hasten smelting by electricity.
Little Milking Engine

Milks cows from time to
time and keeps an inward tank
of liquid, but feeds not
the beasts. Gather the milk
in buckets. Takes and stores milk
vessels from or into inventories
behind or below, preferring to
take from behind and put below,
though filled vessels may return
to the same inventory. Feeds
milk into tanks or pipes below
only where milk exists as
a liquid. Crowd not the
cow pen: only contented beasts wander
by of their own accord.
Milk: %1$smB %2$s
| %1$sRF
Little Mineral-Melting Furnace

A well-insulated electric furnace that melts
stone at great heat.§r Heats
mineral blocks into Blocks of Burning
Stone and at last into Molten
Stone. Click with Stone, Cobblestone
or another mineral block, or use
an item feeder to put one
into the melter. Draw forth
Molten Stone with a bucket or
liquid extractor. When Molten Stone cools,
Obsidian is formed. Remove RF
power or send a redstone signal
to stay the furnace. For automatic
works, a Redstone Metre reveals
the mineral's present stage of melting.
Little Solar Panel

Makes a little power whilst
exposed to sunlight. Of use
in charging LF capacitors
in distant works of modest
consumption. Its inward charge-pump circuit
gathers RF and transfers it
oft. The yield depends upon
the hour and weather.
Click to behold the state
of charge, production and progress.
Charge: %1$s%% of %2$sRF§r | yielding %3$sRF/t | feeding %4$sRF/t
Little Tree Cutter
Fells grown trees before its working face, but gathers not their drops. Send a redstone signal to stay it.
Charge: %1$s%% of %2$sRF§r | work: %3$s%% (%4$ss)
Little Refuse Incinerator

A refuse bin with inward
first-in, first-out slots. Items enter
from every side and are
kept until the queue hath
no space left; thereafter
the oldest stack is burnt.
Supply electric RF/FE power to
hasten its work. It keeps
its inventory when moved elsewhere.
Steel Walkway

A plain walkway for reaching great
machines. It may also be set in
the direction of thy gaze from above.
Click with a Railing to add
a guardrail upon a side: a
near click sets it exactly; a far
click chooses the best fit unaided. Click
again to take away a guardrail.
Steel Walkway Stairs

Click with a Steel Railing to add
or take away guardrails. It cannot be
set with the bottom facing down and hath
no corners; these are no ordinary Stairs.
Raised Steel Walkway

A walkway aligned to the upper
face, joining Steel Poles beneath.
Steel Double-T Support
A fragment of horizontal beam to bear a ceiling.
Steel Floor Grating

A steel covering to adorn thy floor, aligned
to the upper face. Items fall through it.
Window Framed in Steel

A window of triple glass within a
steel frame. Set it in a 1-block
opening in a wall. It uses steel
plates from the Metal Crafts Table progression.
Fence of Steel Mesh

A fence for the works.
Joins not to ordinary fences.
Joins to full blocks when in
line with another mesh fence.
Gate for a Fence of Steel Mesh

A gate for the works that
fits the Fence of Steel Mesh.
It may be set as
a single or a double gate.
Steel Railing

A guardrail for adornment. Hold
railings and click to add
or take away sides. These serve
upon Steel Walkways as well.
Steel Table
A stout table of steel upon four legs.
One-Way Liquid Check Valve

A straight length of liquid pipe
which conducts in one direction alone.
Joins not at its sides and lessens
the rate of flow. Sneak whilst
setting it to reverse its direction.
Liquid Valve Governed by Redstone

A straight length of liquid pipe
which conducts in one direction
alone and joins not at
its sides. Sneak whilst setting it
to reverse its direction. It bars
the flow without redstone power.
Analogue Redstone Liquid Valve

A straight length of liquid pipe
which conducts in one direction alone
and joins not at its
sides. Sneak whilst setting it to
reverse its direction. It bars the
flow without redstone power, restricts the
rate linearly at strengths 1
to 14, and opens unto its
greatest possible flow at strength 15.
Straight Thick Steel Pole

A straight hollow
pole fragment (6x6x16) to
bear thy structures.
Head/Foot for a Straight Thick Steel Pole

A steel fitting for the foot or
head of the thick steel pole (6x6x16).
Straight Thin Steel Pole

A straight hollow pole fragment
(4x4x16) to bear thy structures.
Craft it of steel plates made
upon the Metal Crafts Table.
Head/Foot for a Straight Thin Steel Pole

A steel fitting for the foot or
head of the thin steel pole (4x4x16).
Floor of Treated Wood
Floor tiles for adornment, with sundry textures.
Straight Pole of Treated Wood

A straight length of pole as
broad as a wire relay. It
may stand in place of
wire posts when a particular length
is needed, or bear thy structures.
Head/Foot for a Straight Treated-Wood Pole

A wooden fitting for the foot
or head of straight poles.
Support for a Straight Treated-Wood Pole

A heavy wooden support
fitting for the foot or
head of straight poles.
Side Table of Treated Wood
Requisite when the day's labour is ended.
Stool of Treated Wood

A stout wooden stool, for
within the house or without.

block.immersive_engineer_decor_controls_: Ariadne's Waymarker
Target for Arrows

When struck by an arrow
or set off by hand,
this target sends a redstone
pulse into the block that
bears it. Click with
a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Door Watcher

A detector of players, fixed to
a wall above a door.§r
Lift Button

Points up, down or both
ways, according to where thou
clickest the wall whilst setting
it. A switch that sends
forth a redstone signal
for a little while, as
doth a button. Click with
a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Glass Button

A switch that sends forth
a redstone signal for a
little while, as doth a
button. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the output,
passing through the choices this
switch doth offer. Set it
off whilst already active to
prolong the pulse. Left-click with
a stack of redstone to
fix the pulse at a
time betwixt 0.1s (1) and
6.4s (64). Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Glass Contact Plate

A glass floor plate that
changes hue and sends a
redstone signal whilst pressure
bears upon its top, such
as someone standing thereon, and
for a little while after
that weight is lifted.
Sends forward and downward, without
sound. Its sensors are highly
sensitive. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the output,
passing through the choices
this switch doth offer. Left-click
with a stack of redstone
to set the holding time
betwixt 0.1s (1) and
6.4s (64). Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Glass Clock for the Hours of Day

A little glass device that
sends a redstone signal from
a chosen hour of day unto
a chosen ending hour. Buttons
upon the front set this
span in 24-hour time, where
06:00 is sunrise. They also
set output power and a
value for random delay. This
last setting defers either turning on
or turning off by a
random span; greater values bring
longer waits. Sends into the
block that bears the sensor,
without a switching sound. Click with
a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Adjustable Glass Contact Plate

A glass floor plate that
changes hue and sends a
redstone signal whilst pressure
bears upon its top, such
as someone standing thereon, and
for a little while after
that weight is lifted. Sends
forward and downward, without
sound. Click the upward and
downward touch controls to set
output power, the entity filter,
the number of entities and
sensitivity. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the
output, passing through the choices
this switch doth offer. Left-click
with a stack of redstone
to set the holding time
betwixt 0.1s (1) and
6.4s (64). Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Glass Infrared Watcher of Entities

A little glass device that
watches a chosen volume and
sends a redstone signal
upon seeing an entity. It
watches two blocks above and
below, and the chosen reach
before it, to left and
to right, covering 180
degrees. Little buttons upon the
front govern reach, output strength,
the number of entities seen
and their kind: mobs,
players, animals and the like.
Sends into the block that
bears the sensor, without a
switching sound. Click with a
Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Glass Interval Signal Clock

Sends a signal with
chosen times for being on
and off. Set these with
the fore buttons: §1Blue:
time on§r; §6Yellow: time
off§r; §2Green: signal rising/falling§r; §4Red:
output power§r. The timer begins
in standby for thy
adjustments. Click its front
to set it running. Sends
into the block that bears
the sensor. Click with
a Redstone Torch to
govern the output, passing through
the choices this switch doth
offer. As a Switch
Link target, the timer
changes betwixt running and standby.
Glass Linear Laser Watcher of Entities

A little glass device that
watches one direction and sends
a redstone signal upon sensing
an entity. It watches the
chosen reach in blocks before
it, and half a block
to either side. Little buttons
upon the front govern reach,
output strength, the number of
entities seen and their kind:
mobs, players, animals and the
like. Sends into the block
that bears the sensor, without
a switching sound. Click with
a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Bistable Glass Switch

A switch to turn on
or off by hand, as
thou wouldst a lever. Click
with a Redstone Torch to
govern the output, passing
through the choices this switch
doth offer. Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Little Glass Button

A switch that sends forth
a redstone signal for a
little while, as doth a
button. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the output,
passing through the choices this
switch doth offer. Set it
off whilst already active to
prolong the pulse. Left-click with
a stack of redstone to
fix the pulse at a
time betwixt 0.1s (1) and
6.4s (64). Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Glass Touch Button

A switch that sends forth
a redstone signal for a
little while, as doth a
button. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the output,
passing through the choices this
switch doth offer. Set it
off whilst already active to
prolong the pulse. Left-click with
a stack of redstone to
fix the pulse at a
time betwixt 0.1s (1) and
6.4s (64). Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Bistable Glass Touch Switch

A switch to turn on
or off by hand, as
thou wouldst a lever. Click
with a Redstone Torch to
govern the output, passing
through the choices this switch
doth offer. Left-click with any
dye to colour the switch.
Glass Bar Gauge for Redstone

Fix this display to
a solid block to
behold its redstone power.
Where the block itself supplies
power, the gauge reads
its output; otherwise it
measures indirectly the power
received from neighbouring blocks.
It reads both strong and
weak power. An indirect
reading of weak power
may be somewhat delayed.
Alarm Lamp

A red lamp that blinks upon
sensing a redstone signal from
the block that bears it.
Whilst active it casts forth light.
Alarm Siren

A siren that sounds
an alarm repeatedly upon sensing
a redstone signal from the
block that bears it.
Analogue Voltmeter Gauge for Redstone

Fix this display to
a solid block to
behold its redstone power.
Where the block itself supplies
power, the gauge reads
its output; otherwise it
measures indirectly the power
received from neighbouring blocks.
It reads both strong and
weak power. An indirect
reading of weak power
may be somewhat delayed.
Little Analogue Voltmeter Gauge for Redstone

Fix this display to
a solid block to
behold its redstone power.
Where the block itself supplies
power, the gauge reads
its output; otherwise it
measures indirectly the power
received from neighbouring blocks.
It reads both strong and
weak power. An indirect
reading of weak power
may be somewhat delayed.
Manufactory Watcher of Block Kinds

Sends a redstone signal when
one or more blocks before
it match a chosen kind.
Set it with the rear
buttons: §1Reach§r, how far it
watches; §6Threshold§r, how many matches
are needed; §3Debouncing§r, the
wait that suppresses chatter; §4Output
power§r; §2Filter§r, such as solid,
liquid or log. Click with
a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Machine Button

A switch that sends forth
a redstone signal for a
little while, as doth a
button. Click with a Redstone Torch
to govern the output, passing
through the choices this switch
doth offer. Set it off
whilst already active to prolong
the pulse. Left-click with a
stack of redstone to fix the
pulse at a time betwixt
0.1s (1) and 6.4s (64).
Projectiles may set it off.
Manufactory Redstone Metre Switch

A compact sensor switch that
examines the block upon
which it is mounted. If
that block hath a comparator
output, inventory contents or redstone
power, the switch turns
on and sends full-strength redstone.
Set it upon storage, tanks
or redstone apparatus to turn
the attached signal into
a simple on/off control line.
Manufactory Contact Mat

A floor contact mat for
the works, sending a redstone
signal whilst pressure bears upon
its top, such as someone
standing thereon, and for a
little while after that weight
is lifted. Sends forward and
downward. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the output,
passing through the choices this
switch doth offer. Left-click with
a stack of redstone to
set the holding time betwixt
0.1s (1) and 6.4s (64).
Manufactory Clock for the Hours of Day

A little device that sends
a redstone signal from a
chosen hour of day unto a
chosen ending hour. Buttons upon
the front set this span
in 24-hour time, where 06:00
is sunrise. They also set
output power and a value
for random delay. This last setting
defers either turning on or
turning off by a random
span; greater values bring longer
waits. Sends into the block
that bears the sensor. Click
with a Redstone Torch to govern
the output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Manufactory Dimmer

A dimmer whereby thou
mayst govern redstone power by
hand. Set its rear output
signal betwixt 0 and
15; the height at
which thou clickest determines the
strength. Click with a Redstone
Torch to govern the
output, passing through the
choices this switch doth offer.
Manufactory Door Contact Mat

A floor contact mat for
the works, sending a redstone
signal whilst pressure bears upon
its top, such as someone
standing thereon, and for a

jei.info.immersive_engineer_decor_contro: An engineer’s tool of diamond grade for many labours. Sets torches from thy inventory, serves as axe, shovel, hoe and shears whilst thou sneakest, and fells joined logs when broken whilst sneaking. Mend it, or mend beyond full repair, with diamonds in crafts.
A portable hammer for working ore. Crafting recipes damage it and return the selfsame tool. Striking a target with the hammer doth knock it back.
Verily, Stores a target dimension and block position on use. Sneak-use clears the stored target, and the tooltip shows the saved location whenas one is complete.
A marking tool with a stack limit of one and 100 uses. A successful placement sets an arrow mark upon a sturdy face and spends durability; a failed placement causes no wear.
Verily, Emergency medical tool. It may be used manually, and it can auto-trigger at low health to grant short survival effects ere entering cooldown.
Verily, Portable overworld sleep tool. It advances a safe night to morning without setting spawn and refuses unsafe or non-night use.
Verily, Stores up to 512 of one plain, stackable material type. Hold the box in main hand with matching material in off hand to load it, or use it with an empty off hand to retrieve material.
Verily, Emergency air capsule. It can refill air manually or auto-trigger at low air, then enters cooldown.
Verily, Hand tool for compact rations. It consumes bread, an apple, and an accepted seed to create four Muslee Bars whenas output space is available.
Verily, Fast engineer ration produced by the Muslee Bar Press or its recipe.
Turns lapis into Charged Lapis, spending one experience level, a little health and exertion that causes hunger. Refuses to work when thy health is low.
Keeps one experience level as an item. Use it to gain a level, quench fire, remove harmful effects and heal a little.
A material for the engineer’s tools, used by the reconstructed set of crafts.
A material for the engineer’s tools, used by the reconstructed set of crafts.
Verily, Metal workbench with a dedicated hammer slot, a 3x3 crafting grid, and an output slot. JEI shows it as a crafting catalyst.
A compact furnace fired by coal, with inlet, fuel, outlet, FIFO reserve and auxiliary slots. JEI lists it as a smelting catalyst.
A powered furnace with inlet, outlet, FIFO reserves and an auxiliary slot. JEI lists it as a smelting catalyst.
Heats accepted mineral inputs into Blocks of Burning Stone, yielding Molten Stone besides; it can also cool stored Molten Stone into Obsidian.
An engine for the cold-working recipes implemented by the freezer’s block entity, including the handling of water buckets and further chilling of ice.
A little block for storing liquids in the engine fluid system.
Gathers supported liquids from the world into the engine fluid system.
A passive gatherer of water for the engine fluid system.
A compact source of power beside the engines.
Gathers milk from cows into its inward store, and can feed it to fitting tanks or vessels.
A manufactory transfer engine that gathers and moves items, with adjustable reach and redstone behaviour.
A manufactory transfer engine that casts forth stored items according to its filters and redstone settings.
A manufactory transfer engine that sets filtered blocks or items from its inward stock.
A compact breaker that gathers a target block into its inward drop store, in place of casting drops straight into the world.
A compact tree cutter that gathers joined logs into its inward drop store when its working cycle ends.
